in_marathi.name: Saayan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Saayan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Saayan is a Sanskrit and Hindu name that means 'Protector', 'Guardian'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'saayas', which means 'protection' or 'defense'. Saayan is a powerful name that evokes images of strength and security. It is a name that is often given to a child who is expected to grow up to be a strong and protective figure in his community or family.
